scope: Broadcast exclusions through the actual connection store and SendToAllConnections owner, not group sends or targeted/user sends. F011 is not reused as proof of this separate public path.
prerequisites: Create an independent source branch from the campaign baseline; capture actual fresh default, selected source triples, owner history, related Fowler work, open exact-symbol PR search and applicable documentation.

The unchanged original owner and test source may reuse the byte-identical F011 original build and 27-row test evidence with exact attribution, original commands/timestamps and runtime PE/PDB checks. Do not claim those tests ran again under F012.

Build a separate runnable net12/C#13/BDN0.13 harness and independently execute public OnConnectedAsync and SendAllExceptAsync with actual HubConnectionContext, ordinary JSON serialization, bounded transport frame observers and actual Pipes.

Establish broadcast scope independent of group membership, case-sensitive exclusion/duplicate behavior, empty-connection-store input laziness, all-excluded serialization/cancellation laziness and shared real JSON serialization.

Exercise live caller-owned array/List/read-only-wrapper backing mutations through a real JSON-serialized argument property getter; characterize native ICollection.Contains dispatch and distinguish explicit copied-input controls from an implemented index.
Establish repeated miss enumeration with an untimed instrumented input, and native pending-write completion/cancellation with two real Pipes; do not time instrumentation or inject manager callbacks.

If the fresh default remains the previously captured revision, its exact previously compiled JSON DLL/PDB may be reused with explicit hashes/provenance; execute every F012 broadcast probe again against that real producer, not F011's observations.
decision_gates: A source candidate must preserve observable collection dispatch/live contents, lazy serialization, actual delivery, completion and cancellation.

A copied-input semantics control is not a compiled indexed owner, red/green optimization or timing comparison. Reject only the particular incompatible proposal and leave other designs explicitly unverified.
Do not duplicate or reuse timing from David Fowler's separate small-target SendConnectionsAsync change in upstream69189.
If no compatible candidate is selected, one original-only 12-shape diagnostic profile is authorized; no before/after improvement percentage.

Any compatible candidate needs identical harness/otherwise identical consumer images, focused faithful red/green coverage, applicable API gates and at most three measured comparisons including failed or partial timing attempts.
timing_boundary: Repeated actual public broadcast sends over pre-registered connections, real per-send JSON serialization and synchronous fixed 256-byte per-connection transport buffers. Group creation is not required for timed broadcasts. No network/handshake/connection-creation/stateful-reconnect/production-frequency claim. Native backpressure/cancellation is characterized separately, untimed.
host: Shared Windows VM, serialized CPU-heavy work, maximum2 build nodes, no deliberate power/priority/affinity or unrelated-process changes.
